name: Migrate QA
description: Quality-assurance tooling for content migrations: Tracker/Issue/Connector/Flag entities, generators, and per-node QA notes that auto-run tracker/connector migrations to validate migrated content.
project_description:
Provides quality assurance tools for validating content migrations.

 Main features:

 
 Tracks the approval status of each migrated entity 
 Allows content reviewers to note issues for each migrated entity 
 Can flag potentially problematic things, such as script tags or inline styles in imported text 
 Reports that list all migrated content and filter by QA status, content flag, issue tag, and more 
 
 Benefits:

 
 Content reviewers can tell what still needs to be reviewed 
 The QA process is centralized on the destination site instead of needing to keep separate spreadsheets in sync 
 Developers can quickly find trends of problems and multiple examples of related issues 
 
 Get started by using the Quick Start Guide , or review the other chapters of documentation for more details.
